notes.title: Upcoming pending updates
notes.content:
All good time of day friends. Almost a week has passed since the release and early access, and we, relying on the feedback received, have started to work.
The list of the nearest changes:
1. We plan to drop the price of the game, but in the near future, according to the rules of the Steam platform, we can not do this. Therefore, if you want to purchase a project, but consider that the price is high, wait for a while.
2. We will add more content regarding the SCP fund and its activities, as well as the plotting of the story, so that players not familiar with the universe of this game could understand the content of the project.
3. We move away slightly from the canons of the plot, in order to make the game more interesting. More information will be announced later.
4. The character animation and horror elements will be greatly improved.
5. Three remaining research papers have been finalized.
6. Added sounds, as well as fixed the voice of some story dialogues.

The work is already underway, it's too early to speak about the dates of updates, but we will keep you posted.

Sry for our eng. Good luck.
